title: Customer-to-Product Pathway: SDK language coverage profiling + secured-stream onboarding rubric
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers and platform teams repeatedly submit ad-hoc requests for SDK language bindings, streaming ergonomics, and session/auth patterns. Intake is noisy and inconsistent: we don't have a standard score that maps customer requests to engineering effort, security risk, or business value. This makes prioritization ad-hoc and slows enterprise onboarding for customers whose work spans private deployments or strict auth patterns.

Goal: Define a repeatable intake + scoring rubric and a short onboarding checklist that product managers and solutions engineers can use to convert customer asks into prioritized backlog items or supported customer integrations. The rubric should be lightweight, data-driven, actionable, and integrate with existing signals (Zendesk/Intercom, usage telemetry, and sales ACV). It must cover three core axes: (1) language coverage demand and adoption signal, (2) streaming ergonomics and resumability needs, (3) enterprise auth/session patterns and compliance risk.

Scope: Non-bug feature triage only (SDKs, client libraries, auth flows, streaming ergonomics). Does not include runtime kernel work or infra-only projects (those are handled by ENG tickets). Deliverables: scoring template, triage form, onboarding checklist, mapping rules to backlog buckets (Support, Quick Win, Roadmap Candidate, Dedicated/Consulting), and a pilot with two enterprise customers and Solutions Eng team.

Out-of-scope: full implementation of SDKs; building language bindings — rubric will only score and route requests, not guarantee development without a business trigger.
acceptance_criteria: A scoring rubric with defined weights for Adoption Signal, Business Impact (ACV/renewal), Security/Compliance Risk, Engineering Effort, and Strategic Alignment is documented and approved by PM leadership
A one-page intake form (Confluence + templated Linear issue) is available to Solutions Eng, Sales, and Support; submissions auto-populate key fields for triage

Triage flow maps scores to one of four outcomes with SLAs: Support Response (<=3 days), Quick Win (<=2 sprints), Roadmap Candidate (review in next planning cycle), Escalate to Dedicated/Consulting (customer-specific engagement)
Pilot completed: 2 enterprise request threads processed through rubric; outcomes and time-to-resolution measured and feedback captured
Owners identified: PM owner, Solutions Eng reviewer, and ENG triage contact; runbook established for handoffs and follow-ups
tasks: Draft initial scoring weights and rationale (PM)
Build intake template in Confluence and Linear issue template (PM + DX)
Add lightweight integration to Zendesk keywords to flag SDK/auth-related incoming tickets (Support)
Identify 2 enterprise customers for pilot and run intake with Solutions Eng (PM + SE)
Synthesize pilot learnings and iterate on rubric (PM)
Define mapping from rubric outcome -> Linear label + release pipeline (PM + ENG)
Create short internal training doc and host 30m TL/SE sync (PM)
Measure and report KPI: median time from intake->decision and pilot satisfaction score (PM + Data)
